note: CPL 2026 starting state. matches[] is EMPTY - the season opens 7 Aug 2026 and real results are appended as they are played. Each team's OPENING RATING is not flat: it is the index that team earned across the real 2025 season, derived by running this same engine over data/cpl_2025.json (src/priors.js), decaying as 2026 results arrive (weights.config.json -> prior). The previous 39 synthetic matches are archived in data/cpl_2026_synthetic.json.

teams.name: Jamaica Kingsmen
teams._priorNote: New franchise for 2026 - no 2025 record exists, so no prior can be measured. src/priors.js opens them prior.expansionSigma standard deviations below the 2025 league mean.

_squadMovementNote: Per-team churn between the 2025 and 2026 squads, used by src/priors.js to decide HOW MUCH of a team's 2025 record to trust (weights.config.json -> prior.continuity). squad2025=18 comes from the review's 108 players across six squads. St Kitts' four in-season replacements (Rizwan, Babar Azam, Abbas Afridi, Shafique) are excluded from `exited` because the review flags them as replacements rather than core squad. Jamaica Kingsmen carry no entry: they have no 2025 record to discount, and their standing is already set by the expansion rule.
